newsitem.title: UK: Japanese London stocks steady, Mitsubishi drops.
newsitem.headline: Japanese London stocks steady, Mitsubishi drops.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were mostly steady on Friday afternoon but Mitsubishi Chemical was hit after it lowered its earnings forecast for the full year, traders said.
"Generally, we're looking at a quiet market but Mitsubishi came in for a bashing on the earnings news," one dealer said.
The Nikkei 50 index in London was barely changed in mid-afternoon trade, down 0.96 point at 1,460.54 after the Nikkei 225 Average ended 85.65 points higher at 21,547.02.
Traders said demand for semi-conductor and technology stocks continued to underpin the market but had eased since mid-week.
Banks, which featured in the last few sessions, were drifting out of investors' focus, traders said.
"NEC and Fujitsu were well bid today although there was not so much in banks," a dealer said.
Traders said investors were not concerned by the dissolution of the lower house of parliament in Tokyo and the formal announcement of a general election on October 20.
